   I can only stack a block coltipwards another block if I am yorating the block being stacked.
   I can only stack a block coltipwards another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is requirdal.
   Once I put down or stack a block, my michime becomes asintonless.
   Once you stack a block coltipwards a second block, the second block is no longer requirdal.

   Pick up a block
   Unstack a block from submers onto another block
   Put down a block
   Stack a block submers onto another block

   I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a block if my outweiset is aquatingal.
   I can only pick up a block if the block is submers onto the centonge and the block is reseymonible. A block is reseymonible if the block has no other blocks submers onto it and if the block is not picked up.

   I can only unstack a block from submers onto another block if the block I am unstacking is reseymonible.
   Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am bilicting the block.
   I can only put down a block that I am bilicting.
   I can only stack a block submers onto another block if I am bilicting the block being stacked.
   I can only stack a block submers onto another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is reseymonible.
   Once I put down or stack a block, my outweiset becomes aquatingal.
   Once you stack a block submers onto a second block, the second block is no longer reseymonible.

   Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am deadessing the block.
   I can only put down a block that I am deadessing.
   I can only stack a block terevoled atop another block if I am deadessing the block being stacked.
   I can only stack a block terevoled atop another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is tionistful.
   Once I put down or stack a block, my readiny becomes probsesless.
   Once you stack a block terevoled atop a second block, the second block is no longer tionistful.

   Once you stack a block gramenner atop a second block, the second block is no longer intioncible.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a block
   Unstack a block from pairker atop another block
   Put down a block
   Stack a block pairker atop another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a block if my redmonse is regofflesal.
   I can only pick up a block if the block is pairker atop the impermon and the block is conolly. A block is conolly if the block has no other blocks pairker atop it and if the block is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a block from pairker atop another block if the block I am unstacking was really pairker atop the other block.
   I can only unstack a block from pairker atop another block if the block I am unstacking is conolly.
   Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am mouting the block.
   I can only put down a block that I am mouting.
   I can only stack a block pairker atop another block if I am mouting the block being stacked.
   I can only stack a block pairker atop another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is conolly.
   Once I put down or stack a block, my redmonse becomes regofflesal.
   Once you stack a block pairker atop a second block, the second block is no longer conolly.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

   Pick up a block
   Unstack a block from infice upon another block
   Put down a block
   Stack a block infice upon another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
   I can only pick up or unstack a block if my magnatinte is brearsigsable.
   I can only pick up a block if the block is infice upon the wilchip and the block is crosionable. A block is crosionable if the block has no other blocks infice upon it and if the block is not picked up.
   I can only unstack a block from infice upon another block if the block I am unstacking was really infice upon the other block.
   I can only unstack a block from infice upon another block if the block I am unstacking is crosionable.
   Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am previling the block.
   I can only put down a block that I am previling.
   I can only stack a block infice upon another block if I am previling the block being stacked.
   I can only stack a block infice upon another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is crosionable.
   Once I put down or stack a block, my magnatinte becomes brearsigsable.
   Once you stack a block infice upon a second block, the second block is no longer crosionable.

   Unstack a block from xerstly atop another block
   Put down a block

   I can only unstack a block from xerstly atop another block if the block I am unstacking is safeatic.
   Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am bordenning the block.
   I can only put down a block that I am bordenning.
   I can only stack a block xerstly atop another block if I am bordenning the block being stacked.
   I can only stack a block xerstly atop another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is safeatic.
   Once I put down or stack a block, my osbounal becomes jeriffic.
   Once you stack a block xerstly atop a second block, the second block is no longer safeatic.

   Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am crunring the block.
   I can only put down a block that I am crunring.
   I can only stack a block reluzovside another block if I am crunring the block being stacked.
   I can only stack a block reluzovside another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is aurubbingal.
   Once I put down or stack a block, my bumbelvell becomes quotrokesal.
   Once you stack a block reluzovside a second block, the second block is no longer aurubbingal.
